P1.1.text: Meridian Holdings | Global Gaming & Betting Company

P1.2.text: Meridian Holdings is a leading global gaming and betting company operating across multiple markets with innovative digital solutions and strong industry presence.

P1.3.text: A global iGaming powerhouse operating the full stack of the gaming business: sportsbook, online casino, raffles and competitions in multiple countries.

P1.4.text: All our brands, Meridianbet, Expanse Studios, R Kings Competitions, Classics For A Cause, GM-AG, and MexPlay are supported by a scalable proprietary tech platform tailored for every regulated market worldwide. From B2C to B2B and from street-level retail shops to premium online offers, it is all under one roof.

P1.5.text: With an international team of over 1,400 experts, we own and operate each brand in our portfolio, enabling us to offer consumers and businesses the very best of each gaming segment.

P1.6.text: Our strength is our human capital. We build, maintain, and scale our own technology in real-time.

P1.7.text: We operate a complete iGaming ecosystem across B2B and B2C sectors. Every second, our proprietary products are live on 30+ worldwide web destinations and throughout our multiple bricks-and-mortar locations.

P1.8.text: Our business model is powered by scalable, proprietary technology tailored for 25+ regulated markets.

P2.3.text: Built on a foundation of proprietary technology and strategic acquisitions, the company operates the full stack of the gaming business, spanning sportsbook, online casino, raffles and competitions across more than 25 international markets.

P2.4.text: Today, we are present on all continents, and our portfolio includes a number of global brands: Meridianbet, Expanse Studios, R Kings Competitions, Classics For A Cause, GM-AG and MexPlay—all powered by a scalable proprietary platform designed to adapt to the regulatory, operational and consumer requirements of diverse markets worldwide.
